_readme: One entry per subcommittee page at /service/{slug}/. Text is the old site's, word for word. Rich text: a paragraph is a list of parts; a part is plain text or {"t": text, "b": true (bold), "a": link, "i": true (italic)}. Meeting rules: {"nth": 3, "weekday": 0} is the 3rd Sunday (0 Sunday ... 6 Saturday); add "plus_days" for a day after it; add "skip_months" (1-12) for months with no meeting. Every meeting detail is marked confirm: true until the Area signs off.

body: This committee plans and carries out activities such as picnics and dances to spark interest and encourage participation and support. Fundraisers are important as it generates money to help carry the message of recovery, while welcoming activities that motivate attendance by increasing awareness of how the fellowship helps us as members in our personal recovery.
This committee is responsible for, but not limited to, organizing the yearly area convention and putting on fundraisers.

committees.lead: Grow Together. Carry the Message. Strengthen the Fellowship.

body: Fellowship Development supports the growth of Narcotics Anonymous by helping groups thrive, encouraging service, welcoming new members, and connecting addicts with recovery resources. Together we plant seeds that strengthen our fellowship.
This committee is responsible for the express purpose of carrying the NA message of recovery to men and women “housed” in correctional institutions, hospitals, and recovery houses.
is required to speak in Bergen County jails.
We have commitments ready to open (however need people to fill).
This committee is responsible for informing the public of the existence, location and purpose of Narcotics Anonymous with special emphasis on the addict who still suffers.

body: The purpose of the RCM team is to interact with the Narcotics Anonymous service structure on the Regional level. They are the liaisons that participate in the flow of information between the Area and Regional service body.
